name: Wolf Heart Sample
summary: In the Barrens, Wolf Heart Sample carries diseased wolf tissue from Lordaeron to the Crossroads. The Royal Apothecary Society studies what northern toxins do to Kalimdor’s native beasts.

sections.title: A Toxic Export
sections.body: Plagued wolves in Lordaeron’s ruins gave Apothecary Renferrel the hearts packed into Wolf Heart Sample. They crossed the Great Sea for the Forsaken’s Royal Apothecary Society, which studies venom, blights and biological reagents. A courier carries them to the Crossroads, joining Undercity’s experiments in the scarred Eastern Kingdoms to Kalimdor’s frontier outposts.

sections.title: Helbrim's Research
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim receives Wolf Heart Sample. He studies how toxins from Lordaeron’s Scourge-ravaged lands affect Kalimdor’s native wildlife. The hearts’ preserved toxicity may reveal properties that improve Forsaken poisons and elixirs far from home.

faq.q: What is the Wolf Heart Sample?
faq.answer: Wolf Heart Sample holds tissue preserved from blighted wolves in Lordaeron. Lingering toxicity from the northern plagues gives the Royal Apothecary Society material for studying virulent poisons.

faq.q: Who sent this sample to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zinge sent the sample from Undercity, using wolf hearts Apothecary Renferrel had sent her from Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Helbrim want it?
faq.answer: Apothecary Helbrim studies how toxins from Lordaeron affect Kalimdor’s native beasts. He plans to examine the sample’s venomous properties to advance Forsaken alchemical compounds and poisons.

faq.q: Where does the sample need to be delivered?
faq.answer: Bring Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads, a major Horde settlement in the heart of the Barrens.

angles.text: As an undead, you carry the Royal Apothecary Society’s research into Kalimdor, where it tests northern concoctions against unfamiliar wildlife.
As a member of the Horde, you help carry research reagents across the sea, linking Undercity with Horde outposts in the Barrens.
